Third-party software bundled in this folder
===========================================

mpv.exe, mpv.com
----------------
mpv media player, v0.41.0-dev (git 41f6a6450), Windows build of
21 December 2025, with FFmpeg (git f853d12) and libplacebo v7.358.0
statically linked.

Copyright (C) 2000-2025 mpv/MPlayer/mplayer2 projects and contributors.

mpv is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the
terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free Software
Foundation, either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later
version. Parts of mpv are also available under the LGPL v2.1 or later, but
this build links GPL components (FFmpeg built with GPL options), so the
binary as a whole is distributed under the GPL, version 2 or later.

mpv is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY
WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS
FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the GNU General Public License for details.

Full licence text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.txt
mpv licensing notes: https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv/blob/master/Copyright

Source code
-----------
mpv:     https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv (commit 41f6a6450)
FFmpeg:  https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git (commit f853d12)
libplacebo: https://code.videolan.org/videolan/libplacebo (v7.358.0)

Written offer: for at least three years after you received this copy of
Tsrust IPTV, the distributor will provide, on request, a complete
machine-readable copy of the corresponding source code of the mpv binary in
this folder (including the build scripts), for no more than the cost of
physically performing the distribution. Ask through the project's issue
tracker or the contact address published with the release.

Tsrust IPTV itself is a separate program. It starts mpv.exe as a separate
process and talks to it over mpv's JSON IPC pipe; it does not link mpv.
